events.title: Battle of Chile director Patricio Guzmán dies aged 85
events.description: Passionate documentary maker won international acclaim for unsparing but poetic films exploring the impact of the Pinochet regime in Chile Patricio Guzmán, the film-maker who chronicled Chile’s bloody 1970s political strife and its subsequent social and political turmoil in films such as The Battle of Chile and Nostalgia for the Light, has died aged 85. According to Chilean news outlet Emol , Guzmán died on Tuesday in Paris after a cardiorespiratory arrest. Guzmán’s chief preoccupation throughout his career was the carnage unleashed by Augusto Pinochet’s coup in 1973 against Salvador Allende, Chile’s elected president. He later told the Guardian : “I’m a film-maker who was very marked by the ways of the dictator. It has remained with me for ever. I cannot leave it behind.” However, he resisted the idea that he was an activist, political film-maker, adding: “I’m not a sociologist. Neither am I a politician. I make films that are metaphorical and poetic; I interpret reality through my own personal way of looking.” Continue reading...

events.title: Canada and EU association: Are there other arrangements?

events.title: Dual citizenship means Germany now in competition for talent
events.description: Coach Jürgen Klopp has named several players to his first Germany squad who are eligible to play for other countries. Some still aren't committed to Germany long term.

events.title: Germans have soured on Chancellor Merz — can they trade him?

events.title: Rise of the AfD: The all-or-nothing party

events.title: India heads for driest monsoon in 17 years as El Nino curbs rainfall
events.description: El Nino has put India on track for its driest monsoon since 2009. Meanwhile, the Election Commission has barred both Trinamool factions from using the party's name in by-elections. More with DW.

events.title: Germany faces energy tax losses as EV sales rise

events.title: Women's football in Germany booming, but still much to do

events.title: Venezuela unblocks some news websites censored for years

events.title: Malaysia: Jailed ex-leader Najib allowed house arrest
events.description: Convicted in the 1MDB scandal for embezzling millions, former Prime Minister Najib Razak had repeatedly sought clemency. Malaysia's king has now granted him a "conditional pardon."

events.title: Mbappé quits Nike after career-long partnership for Swiss sports brand On
events.description: France captain Kylian Mbappé has signed with Swiss sportswear brand On, ending a partnership with Nike that began at the start of his career. The deal marks On’s entry into football, with the company also appointing France and Arsenal great Thierry Henry as its football director.

events.title: Venezuela lifts block on some news sites as transition talks resume
events.description: Venezuela has unblocked some news sites that had been censored for years, its telecom regulator said Thursday, as US-backed political transition talks were set to resume. Digital rights group VE Sin Filtro verified access to 17 news sites through several internet providers. However, at least 188 websites remain blocked, it said, including 79 news outlets.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Venezuela lifts block on some news sites as transition talks resume
